about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Learn about Mujaddidun Association and our vision for a better tomorrow.
about.heading: Mujaddidun Charity Development Association - Jordan
about.descriptionP1: Mujaddidun Charity Development Association is a Jordanian society registered with the Ministry of Social Development under No. (1924) since 2009.
about.descriptionP2: The association works to empower youth and serve the community by implementing developmental and humanitarian initiatives, spreading the culture of volunteerism, promoting values of social responsibility, and contributing to sustainable development under the motto 'We Feed . We Shelter . We Empower'.
about.descriptionP3: The association seeks to build a more cohesive society through partnerships with institutions and individuals, and providing qualitative programs that serve various segments of society in Amman and different governorates.
about.missionText: Empowering individuals and communities through sustainable developmental and humanitarian programs, and promoting a culture of volunteering and initiative in service of Jordanian society.
about.visionText: A cohesive, aware, and proactive Jordanian society whose members participate in sustainable development and in creating positive impact.
about.storyText: Mujaddidun Charity Development Association was established in Jordan in 2009 and is registered with the Ministry of Social Development under No. (1924). We started with small youth initiatives, and as challenges grew, our vision expanded to include comprehensive projects in feeding, housing, and empowerment. We believe that every individual has the power to create change, and together we make an impact that spans generations under the motto 'We Feed . We Shelter . We Empower'.
about.valuesText1: Transparency: Clarity in all our dealings and projects.
about.valuesText2: Responsibility: Our commitment to the community and the trust of our partners.
about.valuesText3: Sustainability: Focusing on projects with long-term impact.

1.desc: After relying on intermittent assistance, Abu Ahmed managed, through the empowerment program, to open a small grocery store that provides a decent income for his family of 5.

2.title: Restoration of Um Saif's Home
2.desc: Um Saif lived in a dilapidated house lacking basic living necessities. Thanks to your donations, the house was completely restored and furnished.

3.title: Student Yasmeen's Scholarship
3.desc: Yasmeen was unable to complete her university studies due to financial circumstances. Today, thanks to the sponsorship of benefactors, she is close to graduating with honors in nursing.
